versions.changelog:
Initial release: Automatically detects structural hallmarks of viral folklore and chain messages.

- Identifies 6 pattern families (authority mimicry, urgency/suppression, unfalsifiable claims, faulty causation, numeric theater, emotional triggers)
- Scores "myth-signature" strength for any forwarded/viral claim
- Produces settling questions to clarify claims instead of fact lookup
- Designed for quick triage in chats, media-literacy education, and feed hygiene
- Does not perform actual fact-checking or address hate/satire content
